requested_outcome: A production map experience across every public VII world that helps users decide quickly, shows only verified prices when a real price exists, keeps map and list state synchronized, works on desktop and mobile in all four languages, is published, and is verified at the public destination.
natural_destination: The public VII discovery routes for vacation, events, spa, hourly rooms, attractions and trails, plus their map and list transitions, on vii.spaplus.co in Hebrew, English, Russian and French.
authorization_boundary: Authorized: research public competitor patterns, change VII source and tests, publish the exact verified candidate once, and verify production. Not authorized: invent supplier prices or availability, alter supplier source truth, purchase services, or change unrelated public content.

lesson_bundle.reason: The shared map must survive desktop, mobile and short-height transitions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Adds cross-viewport transition, reload and state-recovery checks.

lesson_bundle.reason: A visible public map change requires deployed mobile evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires public desktop and 390px screenshots plus live interaction evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The map is a touch-first discovery surface on mobile.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Adds full-screen map, safe-area, gesture, selection-card and list-return checks.

lesson_bundle.reason: Marker and card geometry must be judged at the actual destination.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Adds measured marker, cluster, card and toolbar geometry checks.

lesson_bundle.reason: The change is shared by six worlds and four languages.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Expands regression to every world and locale rather than a vacation-only sample.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request is for a trustworthy decision experience, not a decorative map.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires map-list synchronization, meaningful marker values and useful selected-place actions.

lesson_bundle.reason: Map interaction may change URL and search state but must not create duplicate indexable routes.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Adds URL, back/reload and canonical invariance checks.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only vacation markers show prices while another world remains generic despite having a verified price.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Create one shared typed marker-value resolver and inventory every world adapter.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Fixtures and live samples prove verified prices render in vacation, events, spa, hourly and attractions whenever source data contains a price.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A marker displays an invented, stale or wrong-date price.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Render price markers only from the same accepted result object and current date/filter state; otherwise use a semantic non-price marker.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Price provenance tests cover dated, undated and missing-price records and compare marker value with the corresponding list card.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The selected card, map button or controls disappear on mobile or short-height screens.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use a single responsive map shell with explicit safe-area layers and no body-state-dependent hiding.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Automated geometry and interaction checks pass at desktop, 390px mobile and short-height viewports for all worlds.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Panning or zooming makes map pins, list cards and result counts disagree.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep one eligible result pool and make viewport filtering an explicit pending state applied by the user.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Pan, zoom, search-this-area, reset and back/reload checks prove deterministic synchronized IDs and counts.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Dense or identical coordinates hide places or make selection impossible.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve clustering and spiderfying with explicit active-marker focus and list synchronization.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Dense and identical-coordinate fixtures expose every place and keep active marker/card paired.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Hebrew works but LTR labels, cards or controls clip or reverse.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Localize map UI strings and direction at the shared component boundary.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Hebrew, English, Russian and French screenshots and text-direction assertions pass.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The code is changed but the public map is not actually published or verified.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Bind release evidence to one commit, one deployment identity and post-publication browser proof.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The exact public release shows the changed marker/card behavior and rollback identity is recorded.

affected_family: shared map marker, cluster, selected-place card and map/list controls
loading, empty, error, missing-price, single-result, dense-result and viewport-change states

sources.label: VII accepted map truth and static place-map policy
Airbnb public search and map interaction guidance
Airbnb search ranking and geographic distribution guidance
Booking public sorting and price-transparency description

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the shared price-marker resolver and responsive selected-place card work for one verified-price record and one missing-price record.
checks: Compare marker price with its corresponding list card and current query state.
Exercise marker selection, close, pan, zoom and list return on desktop and 390px mobile.
Confirm the missing-price record shows a semantic marker and never a fabricated amount.

attack_questions: Can any world show a price not present in the same accepted result object?
Can a map/list toggle, reload, back action or viewport transition lose the result state or hide the primary control?
Can overlapping coordinates, a long translated title or a missing image make a place unreachable?
Can map, list and visible count disagree after deliberate pan and zoom?
Can a public user reach a broken tile, missing attribution, blank map or stale selected card?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Production screenshots and interaction logs from the exact deployed release across the six world routes and representative locales/viewports.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: A dedicated map QA matrix plus full affected tests covering all adapters, worlds, languages, viewports and state transitions.

effectiveness.baseline: The current shared map has inconsistent marker semantics between worlds and the latest broad QA reported missing selected cards or hidden mobile map controls in several worlds.
effectiveness.target: All dedicated map QA checks pass on the first published candidate, with zero repeated user corrections for map price truth, controls, selection or responsive behavior.
